active_span_meanings.meaning: The requester authorizes the agent to choose an independent random complex concept and test integrated keyword realization in actual image pixels. The craft setting, selected keywords, staging and detailed criteria are agent-authored testcase choices, not supplied requester definitions.

Use the attached photograph as a visual reference. This arm independently chooses visible facial appearance and short dark hair as its reference scope; it makes no claim about the depicted person's actual identity, age or personality.

agent_direction_comparison: A playful staged pause in a ceramic atelier makes the flower hands and unilateral wink readable with a supported raised heel, while clay/glaze traces give the environment a reason to exist.
A seated glazing inspection would foreground craft action but would weaken the independently drawn standing heel-lift criterion.
selected_direction: Full-length invited portrait in front of a ceramic workbench: quiet invitation, playful face-and-hand pose and physically grounded asymmetrical feet. Sensual 1 is a subtle warm personable attraction through direct camera acknowledgment and softly lit facial presence; fetish 0 adds no special focus; surreal 0 retains ordinary material and gravity; creativity 1 supplies restrained concrete craft traces.
